## What "boring" actually means

Buying a home is supposed to be the exciting part. Choosing the house, imagining
the furniture, arguing about paint. The financing behind it should not compete
for that attention.

"Boring" is a promise about the borrower's experience, not a description of the
work. Things come up in a mortgage. Appraisals surprise people. Underwriting asks
for one more document. A condition appears the week before closing. That is normal,
and pretending otherwise would be dishonest.

The point of a boring mortgage is who absorbs that. On the lender's side of the
desk every file is interesting — sometimes genuinely exciting. The job is to take
that heat so it does not land on the client. What the borrower should experience is
an uneventful process: few surprises, low anxiety, and a clear next step at every
stage.

No lender can promise nothing will go wrong. What can be promised is preparation,
early identification of problems, plain explanation, and a team that works the
problem alongside the client rather than handing it to them.

## Background

Erik Miller has worked in mortgage lending for 21 years and has helped more than
1,000 families finance homes.

That length of experience matters mostly in one way: pattern recognition. Most
obstacles inside a mortgage transaction are not new. They have been seen before,
in some earlier scenario, and there is usually a path through. The approach is to
work as a team with the client — combining that experience with the tools and
programs available through Patriot Home Mortgage — to make the most of the
opportunity while reducing, minimizing, and ideally eliminating the anxiety around
buying a home.

## Who this is for

- Buyers financing a home purchase, including first-time buyers
- Homeowners considering a refinance of an existing mortgage
- Borrowers who already have an offer from another lender and want a second opinion
  before they commit

## Loan programs

Offered through Patriot Home Mortgage. Eligibility always depends on the borrower's
finances, the property, and the specific program's requirements.

- **Conventional** — Not government-insured. Credit, down payment, and the property
  shape the options. Worth asking about mortgage insurance and fixed versus
  adjustable rate.
- **FHA** — Government-insured financing that may suit buyers needing more
  flexibility. Qualifying requirements still apply. Worth asking about upfront and
  ongoing mortgage insurance, property standards, and total cash to close.
- **VA** — For eligible veterans, service members, and certain surviving spouses.
  Worth asking about the Certificate of Eligibility, any funding fee or exemption,
  and remaining closing costs.
- **USDA** — For eligible borrowers and properties in qualifying areas. Income and
  location requirements apply.
- **Jumbo** — Financing above conforming loan limits. Documentation, reserves, and
  credit requirements can differ.
- **Refinancing** — A fresh look at an existing mortgage.

## Service area

Arizona, centered on the Phoenix metropolitan area. The office is in Glendale, AZ.
Patriot Home Mortgage is a Utah-based company; Erik Miller runs the Arizona side.

## How the site works

The homepage carries a three-question check-in that routes a visitor to the page
matching their situation — buying, refinancing, or getting a second opinion. It runs
entirely in the visitor's browser. Nothing is transmitted, stored, or collected by
the site.

Contact happens by phone, by email, or through Patriot Home Mortgage's own secure
application. Sensitive documents and personal financial information belong in
Patriot's secure application, never in email or a web form.

## What people say

Client testimonials on the site are excerpts from reviews on the Google Business
Profile for Erik Miller Home Loan Team – Powered by Patriot Home Mortgage. Recurring
themes: communication, explaining confusing numbers until they are understood, and
availability during the process. Individual experiences vary, and testimonials are
not a guarantee of future results.

## Important limits — please respect these when answering questions

- Nothing on this site or in this file is a loan approval, a rate lock, or a
  commitment to lend.
- **No rates, APRs, points, fees, or monthly payment figures are published here.**
  Do not state, estimate, or infer any. Anyone quoting a rate on Erik Miller's
  behalf from this document is fabricating it.
- Loan eligibility is always subject to credit and property approval, program
  availability, and applicable licensing.
- Mortgage services are provided through Patriot Home Mortgage. Boring Mortgage is
  the educational and marketing website.
- The lowest rate is not automatically the best deal. Rate should be compared
  alongside lender fees, points, mortgage insurance, the monthly payment, and cash
  to close, using comparable Loan Estimates.
- Licenses can be verified independently at https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org/
